text: The cough is completely dry; I haven't produced any mucus at all. As for my legs, there is no noticeable swelling, and I have not lost any weight recently, though I do feel much more winded than usual.

text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD). The combination of a three-month history of exertional dyspnea, a dry cough, and imaging showing hyperinflated lungs with flattened diaphragms is classic for COPD, likely exacerbated by your underlying cardiovascular history.
